༄༅/ /bstan bcos chen po sdom gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam par bshad pa thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba las skabs gnyis pa'i rnam par bshad

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bstan bcos chen po sdom gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam par bshad pa thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba las skabs gnyis pa'i rnam par bshad pa bzhugs lags so// (2) gnyis pa byang sems kyi sdom pa'i nyams len bshad pa la gsum ste/ sems bskyed kyi dbye ba spyir bstan/ theg chen sems bskyed bye brag tu bshad/ bstan pa rnam par dag pas mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ sems bskyed la ni/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ spyir byang chub tu sems bskyed pa tsam gyi sems bskyed la ni/ nyan thos pa'i lugs dang*/ theg pa chen po'i lugs rnam pa gnyis yod de/ nyan thos sde gnyis kyi lung nas bshad pa dang*/ theg pa chen po dbu sems kyi gzhung nas bshad pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir ro// nyan thos rnams kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i sems bskyed la yang*/ thob bya byang chub kyi sgo nas rnam pa gsum yod de/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su sems bskyed pa gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ 'dul ba lung las/ kha cig ni nyan thos su sems bskyed do// kha cig ni rang rgyal du sems bskyed do// kha cig ni sangs rgyas su sems bskyed do zhes bshad pas so// 'on kyang gsum po de yi sems bskyed kyi cho ga spyod pa deng sang nyung ste/ nyan thos kyi bstan pa 'bras bu'i dus lnga brgya pa phrag gsum/ sgrub pa'i dus lnga brgya pa phrag gsum nub nas/ da lta lung gi dus yin pas na'o// spyi'i don ni/ nyan thos kyi skad dod shra ba ka zhes pa yin la/ de yang slob dpon las thos pa'i gdams ngag gzhan la sgrogs par byed pas na/ thos sgrog pa dang*/ gzhan la gdams ngag nyan cing thos par byed pas na nyan thos zhes bya ste/ ji skad du/ mgon po de ring bdag cag nyan thos gyur// byang chub pa yi sgra yang sgrags par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// nyan thos dang theg chen gnyis la lam dang sems bskyed kyi sgo nas bzhag pa dang*/

sde snod dam grub mtha'i sgo nas bzhag pa gnyis las/ 'dir ni sde snod kyi sgo nas bye mdo gnyis bzhag pa'o// des na nyan thos lugs kyi sems bskyed yin na/ nyan thos kyi sems bskyed yin pas ma khyab par grub pa ni/ nyan thos lugs la theg pa gsum gyi rigs gsum nas/ byang chub gsum gyi bar yod par/ rgyud sde spyi rnam dang*/ mngon rtogs ljon shing sogs las gsung pas shes so// theg pa chen po'i lugs kyi sems bskyed la/ dbu ma lugs dang*/ sems tsam lugs rnam pa gnyis su yod de// 'dir bstan theg chen lugs ni/ nyan thos lugs kyi bzlas phye (3) ba yin zhing*/ de la dbu sems kyi lugs gnyis su yod pa'i phyir te/ dbu sems gnyis po de sde snod kyis phye ba'i theg pa chen po pa yin pa'i phyir ro// 'di'i thad/ gsung rab dgongs gsal las/ de gnyis ka yang bla med byang chub tu sems bskyed pa kho na yin gyi/ byang chub gsum du sems bskyed pa'i tshul ni med do zhes gsungs/ de'i don dbu ma pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ sems tsam pa'i sems bskyed gnyis bla med byang chub tu sems bskyed pa kho na dang*/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kho na yin gyi/ de la byang chub gsum du sems bskyed pa'i tshul med ces pa'i don yin gyi/ sems tsam lugs la byang chub gsum du sems bskyed pa 'dod dgos pa 'dra ste/ phar phyin dka' 'grel gyi rigs kyi skabs dang*/ ngo mtshar gsum ldan sogs su bye mdo sems gsum gyi lugs la theg pa gsum gyi rigs gsum dang*/ lam sgrod tshul gsum dang*/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub par bshad cing*/ bla med byang chub tu sems bskyed pa kho nas mthar thug nyan rang gi byang chub thob pa ji ltar 'thad/ sems tsam man chad kyi lugs la mthar thug theg pa gsum dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la gnas skabs theg pa gsum dang*/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub par gzhung lugs tshad ldan du ma las bshad pas so// snyam pa ni rang gi ma go ba'i dogs pa'i gzhi tsam lags so// gzhung 'di la/

༈ /mkhas pa kha cig shākya mchog ldan gis dri ba/theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la// dbu ma sems tsam lugs gnyis su// nges shing len pa'i cho ga dang*/ ltung ba phyir bcos la sogs pa// so sor nges na rgyud sde las// gsung pa'i sems bskyed cho ga de// gsum po gang gis lugs dang mthun// zhes pa'i lan/ kun mkhyen gyis/ spyir 'di'i skabs gnyis par theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la/ dbu sems kyi lugs gnyis su nges par gsung pa de skabs thob kyi theg pa chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi sems bskyed la de gnyis su nges pa'i don yin gyi/ mdo rgyud nas gsung pa'i sems bskyed kyi lugs thams cad de gnyis su nges par ston pa ga la yin/ de ltar na/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yan lag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces pa la yang*/ sems bskyed thams cad der nges na/ theg chen gyi sems bskyed de yang der nges sam/ zhes dang*/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// zhes pa nas/ sgra gnyan chu bo sprin rnams kyi// rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// zhes pa la yang*/ sa dang gser la sogs pa'i bem po nyi shu rtsa gnyis po theg chen sems bskyed kyi dbye bar bshad dam/ zhes sogs gzhung lugs chen po rnams la yang dri ba mang ches pa 'dra'o// des na/ rgyud sde nas gsung ba'i sems bskyed la lugs mang du yod de/ dbang bskur gyi sta gon dang*/ 'jug pa'i gnas skabs su sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga dang*/ sgrub thabs thams cad kyi sngon 'gro bsod nams tshogs bsags kyi skabs su sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga dang*/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga brgyud pa khyad par gnyis ldan lta bu sogs yod pa las/ dang po gnyis la kyai rdor 'grel pa lugs lta bu dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed dang tshul mtshungs pa yang yod mod kyi phal cher ni lugs gnyis po gang dang yang mthun pa'i nges pa med de/

dngos gzhi'i skabs su sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga dang*/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga brgyud pa khyad par gnyis ldan (4) la sngags sdom len pa'i sngon 'gro'i gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga yin pas cho ga bsdus pa'i lugs yin pa'i phyir dang*/ lugs gnyis po ni dngos gzhi la byang sems kyi sdom pa len pa'i skabs yin pas cho ga rgyas pa'i lugs ma yin par/ brgyud pa khyad par gnyis ldan gyi dbang gi sngon 'gro'i cho ga ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs su/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bsngo ba yod pas sems tsam lugs kyang ma yin/ yang sbyor ba'i skabs su yan lag bdun tshang ba med cing*/ skyabs 'gro dngos gzhir bsdus pa dang*/ bslab pa brjod pa'i skabs su sems tsam lugs kyi rtsa ltung bzhi brjod pas/ dbu ma lugs kyang ma yin pas/ rgyud sde nas gsung pa'i sems bskyed kyi lugs de/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbu sems gang gis kyang lugs yin mi dgos so// zhes gsungs/ des na rdo rje theg pa ba dbu ma par bzhed pa na/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sems bskyed la sogs pa dbu ma pa'i sems bskyed yin kyang*/ sems tsam lugs kyi bzlas phye ba'i dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed min pa dang*/ 'di ltar na lugs gnyis gang rung gi sems bskyed dang*/ sngags sdom gyi gzhi mthun yod kyang*/ skabs gnyis pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi sngags sdom med par yang grub bo// 'o na lugs gnyis byung tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ dbu ma lugs ni/ sdong po bkod pa dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ dkon brtsegs sogs kyi mdo'i rjes su 'brang nas/ dang por 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis gsung pa/ mgon po klu sgrub las brgyud de/ zhi ba lha'i rjes su 'brang nas/ dze ta ri dang*/ jo bo puṇya shrī la sogs pa'i bka' srol dpal ldan sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad pa 'di yin la/

sems tsam lugs ni byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 'ga' zhig gi rjes su 'brang nas/ dang por mgon po byams pas gsung pa/ slob dpon thogs med las brgyud de tsand+ra go mi'i rjes su 'brang nas jo bo rje la sogs pa'i bka' srol dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdam pa rnams kyis phyag srol du mdzad pa de yin no// lugs de gnyis kyi spyod pa sems bskyed kyi ngo bo dang*/ de 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga yang ni tha dad yin pa dang*/ nyams par byed pa'i ltung ba dang ni/ nyams pa phyir bcos pa'i thabs dang*/ der ma zad bsrung ba'i bslab par bya ba'ang so sor te tha dad du yod pa yin te/ lugs de gnyis la lta ba mtho dman tha dad du yod pas de dang mthun par sems bskyed kyi lugs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ rjes 'jug gi gdul byas gnyis ka nyams su len pa la 'gal ba med de/ dper na nyan thos la so thar rigs bdun dang*/ theg pa chen po la sems bskyed kyi sdom pa thob byed kyi cho ga so sor gsungs kyang*/ gang zag gcig gis gnyis ka nyams su len pa la 'gal ba med pa bzhin no/ ༈ /gzhung 'di la mkhas pa kha cig gis/ lta bas cho ga 'byed pa ni// dbu ma'i lta ba dang ldan pa// de la byang sa'i cho ga yis// sems bskyed sdom pa mi skye 'am// zhes pa'i lan/ kun mkhyen gyis/ de nyid lta ba tha dad las// cho ga yang ni tha dad yin// zhes pa'i don/ dbu sems gnyis la lta ba tha dad du yod pas/ de dang mthun pa'i cho ga tha dad pa gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bcas zhes pa'i don yin gyi cho ga gnyis po lta ba tha dad pa kho nas len dgos zhes pa'i don ma yin no// gal te lta ba tha dad la/ cho ga (5) tha dad du bcas pa lta ba tha dad kho nas len dgos na/ theg pa chen po'i lta ba dang ldan pas/ nyan thos kyi sde snod nas gsung pa'i gsol bzhi'i las kyi sdom pa len pa mi rung bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsung ngo*// de gnyis kyi lta ba tha dad du yod de/

sems tsam pas/ sa bcu pa las/ kyai rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo/ zhes dang*/ lang gshegs las/ phyi rol snang ba yong med de// sems ni sna tshogs rnams su snang*// zhes gsung pa ltar/ snang ba thams cad sems dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ de phyir gnyis stong gang yin pa// de ni de'i yang de nyid yin// zhes gsung pa ltar/ gzung 'dzin bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid dang*/ shes pa thams cad kyi steng gi gnyis med kyi shes pa rang rig rang gsal bden grub tu 'dod la/ dbu ma pas/ de phyir brten 'byung rig pa 'di yis ni// lta ngan drwa ba mtha' dag gcod par byed// zhes gsung pa ltar/ rten 'brel gyi rtags las/ snang ba thams cad bden par med pa dang*/ dbu ma brgyan las/ yod min med min yod med min// gnyis ka'i bdag nyid kyang min la// mtha' bzhi las grol dbu ma pa// ces pa ltar/ gnas lugs kyi lta ba yod med la sogs pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos nyid zung 'jug la bzhed pa'i phyir ro// de gnyis sems bskyed kyi ngo bo tha dad du 'dod de/ sems tsam pas de bden grub dang*/ dbu ma pas/ de bden pas stong par 'dod pa'i phyir ro// de gnyis kyi blang ba'i yul tha dad du 'dod de/ sems tsam pa ltar na/ mgon po byams pas/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi gang*// yon tan lhag par brtson byas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyong la spangs la brten// zhes gsung pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'am/ de ma 'byor na/ sdom nyi las/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan las blang bar bya// zhes gsung pa ltar gyi bla ma las blang bar bya'o// dbu ma pa ltar na/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag gis// mtshan nyid mdor bsdus mkhyen par mdzod// chog shes snying rje tshul khrims ldan// nyon mongs spong ba'i shes rab can// de dag gis ni khyod bstan na// khyod kyis mkhyen gyi grub par mdzod// ces dang*/

spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*// zhes dang*/ bslab btus las/ sdom pa gzung ba yang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas la bsgom pa lhur byed pa sdom pa dang ldan pa las nod do// zhes gsung pa ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan pa las len no// 'o na mtshan nyid de dag ldan pa'i bla ma med pa'am/ yod kyang srog dang tshangs spyod kyi bar chad du 'gyur na ji ltar byed ce na/ rang nyid kyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i spyan sngar sems bskyed blang pas chog par dbu sems gnyis kar mthun te/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blang ba de yang*/ gal te yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang zag med par gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar bdag nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag (6) par blang bar bya ste/ 'di ltar spyan sngar bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs pa'i tsog tsog pur 'dug pas 'di skad du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gsol bar 'tshal te/ de dag gi spyan sngar/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ gang yang 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslab pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad slob par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu na da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob pa rnams bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo*// zhes brjod par bya ste/

lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod nas blang bar bya'o// lhag ma thams cad ni snga ma bzhin du rig par bya'o// zhes gsung zhing*/ bslab pa kun las btus pa las kyang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon sum du bsgom nas/ bdag nyid kyi nus pa dang yang sbyar la/ sdom pa bzung zhes bya ba dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan// zhes dang*/ slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal gyis/ rnam pa de lta bus dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyan sngar ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// len pa po'i gang zag ni/ sems tsam pa ltar na/ so thar rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan zhing smon pa sems bskyed thob pas tshul khrims gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed len par byed de/ byang sa las/ de la byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa/ rab tu byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa tshul khrims kyi phung po bslab pa gsum po 'di dag la bslab par 'dod cing*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbu ma pa ltar na/ de las gzhan pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyis blang pas skye bar bzhed pa yin no// yang byang sems kyi sdom pa skye ba dang*/ gnas pa'i brten du/ so thar rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan pa nges par dgos sam mi dgos she na/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ de'i rten du nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so thar rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan pa mi dgos te/ rje btsun gyis rtsa ltung 'khrul spongs las/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob pa'i rten du mi rung ste/ so so thar pa ni/ gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang*/ bud med ma yin pa gzhan la mi skye la/ byang chub kyi sems ni/ 'gro ba mtha' dag la skye bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang gnas pa'i rten du yang mi 'thad de/

so so thar pa ni shi nas gtong la/ byang chub sems dpa' ni ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du mi gtong ba'i phyir ro// zhe na zhes gzhan gyi dogs pa bkod nas nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so so thar pa 'di ni/ sdom pa thob pa dang gnas pa'i rten du mi rung bar khyed smra ba bzhin du kho bo cag kyang smra'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// sems tsam pa'i lugs la/ byang sdom skye ba'i rten du so thar rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan pa dgos te/ jo bos/ so so thar pa rigs bdun gyi// zhes sogs dang*/ gzhung las/ des na sems tsam pa yi lugs// zhes pa nas/ thog mar so so thar pa long*// zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/

(7) gnas pa'i rten du mi dgos te/ so thar rigs bdun ni/ rten shi 'phos nas gtong la/ byang sems kyi sdom pa de ltar mi gtong ba yin pa'i phyir/ cho ga'i khyad par ni/ chos rje pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang*/ bdag nyid chen po'i gsung sgros/ lho pa rin chen dpal gyis bris pa'i spyod 'jug gi ṭīkka las 'byung ba ltar bshad na/ sbyor ba'i cho ga la khyad par yod de/ dbu ma pa rnams kyis spyod 'jug las 'byung ba ltar mchod pa/ skyabs 'gro/ sdig bshags/ rjes su yi rang ba/ chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa/ bsngo ba ste yan lag bdun du mdzad la/ sems tsam pa rnams kyis ni/ sdom nyi las/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal ci nus mchod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ phyag dang mchod 'bul gnyis byed kyi/ lhag ma rnams mi byed do// de ltar yan lag bdun pa byed mi byed kyi khyad par/ ṭīkka gsung sgros ma las/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed ni/ bshan pa sogs so thar sdom pas ma bsdam pa la yang skye ba'i dbang du byas nas/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba tshab che ba sbyang nas/ sdom pa skye ba'i ched du yan lag bdun pa mdzad pa yin la/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed skye ba la/ so thar gyi sdom pas rgyud bsdam pa sngon du song ba'i dbang du byas nas/ tshogs bsogs pa'i yan lag phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul gnyis byed kyi/ sdig pa bshags pa sogs mi mdzad par gsungs so// gzhan yang*/ dbu ma pa rnams kyis ni/ bar chad dri ba mi mdzad/ sems tsam pa rnams kyis ni/ byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo shes sam/ zhes sogs bar chad dri bar mdzad pa'i phyir ro// dngos gzhi la khyad par yod de/ dbu ma pa rnams kyis ni/ smon 'jug gnyis po cho ga gcig gis stabs gcig tu len la/

sems tsam pa rnams kyis ni/ thog mar smon pa blang nas/ de'i rjes su byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bslab te bslab bya rnams nyams 'og tu tshud par byas nas bsgrub par nus na/ 'jug sdom len par byed pa'i phyir ro// 'jug chog la khyad par yod de/ dbu ma pa rnams kyis ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// ces sogs rang dga' ba bsgom pa dang*/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// zhes sogs gzhan dga' ba bsgom du 'jug pa mdzad la/ sems tsam pa rnams kyis ni/ mkhyen par gsol ba mdzad de/ ji skad du/ 'di ltar nod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ma lang par de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs de nyid kyi spyan sngar zhes pa nas/ lan gnyis sam gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya'o// zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba tha dad du yod de/ dbu ma pas nam snying las 'byung ba ltar/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang*/ sems tsam pas/ sdom nyi las gsung pa ltar/ rtsa ltung bzhir 'dod pa'i phyir ro// phyir bcos kyi tshul so sor yod de/ dbu ma pas bslab btus su/ rmi lam 'phags pa nam snying po'i// mdun du 'dug te bshags par bya// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ skya reng la gsol ba btab nas/ nam mkha'i snying po rmi lam du byung ba la/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bshags pa dang*/ sems tsam pas sdom nyir/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya// zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags// gcig gi mdun du (8) lhag ma rnams// nyon mongs mi mongs bdag sems bzhin// zhes bshad pa ltar mdzad pa'i phyir ro// de'i don ni/ kun dkris chen pos rtsa ltung bzhi spyad na/ nyi ma'i gsum cha 'das nas sdom pa gtong bas/ slar skyar nas len par byed/ de 'bring gis spyad na/ gang zag gsum gyi drung du bshags sdom byed/ de chung ngus spyad pa'i nyes byas rnams gang zag gcig gi mdun du bshags par byed ces pa'o// bslab par bya ba so sor yod de/

dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ dbang rnon la bcu bzhir dbye ba/ dbang 'bring la bzhir bstan pa/ dbang brtul la gcig tu bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdo nam snying las gsung pa bslab btus las tshigs bcad du byas pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi skor phrogs pa// phas pham pa yi ltung bar 'dod// dam pa'i chos ni spongs byed pa// gnyis par thub pas gsung pa yin// tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la// ngur smrig 'phrog dang rdeg pa dang*// brtson rar 'jug par byed pa dang*// rab tu byung ba 'bebs pa dang*// srog dang 'bral byed gsum pa yin// mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*// log par blta ba 'dzin pa dang*// zhes rgyal po la 'byung ba lnga dang*/ blon po la 'byung ba ni/ sngar gyi dang po bzhi'i steng du/ grong la sogs pa 'jig pa yang*// rtsa ba'i ltung bar rgyal bas gsung*// zhes pa dang lnga yin la/ las dang po pa la 'byung ba brgyad ni/ blo sbyang ma byas sems can la// stong pa nyid ni ston pa dang*// sangs rgyas nyid la zhugs pa dag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub ldog pa dang*// so so thar pa yongs spangs te// theg pa che la sbyor ba dang*// slob pa'i theg pas chags la sogs// spongs bar 'gyur ba min zhes 'dzin// pha rol dag kyang 'dzin 'jug dang*// rang gi yon tan brjod pa dang*// rnyed pa dang ni bskur bsti dang*// tshigs bcad rgyu yi gzhan smod dang*// bdag ni zab mo bzod pa 'o// zhes/ log pa nyid ni smra ba dang*// dge sbyong chad pas gcod pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi sbyin byed dang*// sbyin pa len par byed pa dang*// zhi gnas 'dor bar byed pa dang*// yang dag 'jog gi longs spyod rnams// kha bton byed la sbyin pa ni// de dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste// sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu// zhes gsungs so// 'di dag rgyal po la 'byung ba'i dang po bzhi dang*/ blon po la 'byung ba'i dang po bzhi ni/

ltung ba gcig pas ngo bo'i sgo nas bcu bzhi yin la/ bco brgyad du phye ba ni rten gyi sgo nas yin zhing*/ mtshams med lnga po so sor byed na nyer gnyis su byas pa yang yod do// 'o na rten gyi sgo nas bco brgyad du byed pa de dag rgyal blon las dang po pa gsum char la ltung bar 'gyur na ni/ so sor bcas pa la dgos pa med cing*/ gcig la bcas pa gzhan la mi 'byung na ni/ de thams cad kyang byang sems dbang rnon gyi dbang du byas pa 'gal lo zhe na/ gang zag de dag re res kyang thams cad bsrung dgos mod kyi/ so sor bcas pa ni gang la 'byung nye ba de'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ bslab btus las/ gal te rgyal rigs la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' yin na/ ji ltar de dag gi ltung bar nges shing*/ gzhan la ni min/ zhes sogs kyi dogs pa bkod nas/ de'i 'jug thogs su 'di la nyes pa med do// gang du gang la mang du byung ba de la der rang gi ming nas smos te bstan pas 'jigs pa skyed pa'i phyir te/ thams cad kyis (9) kyang phan tshun du ltung ba thams cad spang bar bya'o// zhes sogs gsungs so// gnyis pa dbang 'bring gi bslab bya bzhir bstan pa ni/ thabs la mkhas pas mdo'i don/ bslab btus las/ byang chub sems ni yongs dor dang*// chags dang ser sna mi 'thad pas// slong la sbyin par mi byed dang*// sgrims te dga' bar byed pa na// sems dpa' la yid mi bzod par// khros pas sems can brdeg pa dang*// nyon mongs pa dang gnas mthun pas// log ltar bcos pa ston pa 'o// zhes gsung pa rnams so// gsum pa dbang brtul gyi bslab bya gcig tu bstan pa ni/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems la bslab pa ste/ rgyal po la gdam pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po khyod ni 'di ltar/ bya ba mang ba/ byed pa mang ba ste/ thams cad kyis thams cad du sbyin pa nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar la bslab par mi nus kyi/

de las gzhan rgyal po chen pos kyang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'dun pa dang*/ dad pa dang*/ don du gnyer ba dang*/ smon pa gsum 'gro yang rung*/ 'greng yang rung*/ 'dug kyang rung*/ nyal yang rung*/ bsdad kyang rung*/ za yang rung*/ 'thung yang rung*/ rtag par rgyun du dran pa yid la bzung ste sgoms shig gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig rjes su yi rang nas kyang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phul cig phul nas sems can thams cad thun mong du gyis shig de nas sems can thams cad kyi chos yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar nyin gcig bzhin du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sngos shig rgyal po chen po khyod de ltar na/ rgyal srid kyang byed la rgyal po'i bya ba yang nyams par mi 'gyur la byang chub kyi tshogs kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// des na smon pa byang chub kyi sems spongs ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rno 'bring brtul gsum thams cad la rtsa ba'i ltung ba shin tu lci ba yin te/ mdo bsdus pa las/ gal te bskal pa bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu// spyod kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom nyid du sems bskyed na// de ni tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa ste// sems bskyed de ni phas pham bas kyang shin tu lci// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' la// ltung ba'i nang nas lci ba ste// 'di ltar de ni byung gyur na// sems can kun gyi don la dman// zhes so// gnyis pa sems tsam lugs kyi bslab bya la/ pham 'dra'i nyes byas bzhi spong ba dang*/ yan lag gi nyes byas bzhi cu zhe drug spong ba gnyis las/ dang po la pham 'dra bzhi ni/ sdom nyi las/ rnyed dang bskur bsti chags pa yis// bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*// sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la// ser snas chos nor mi gter dang*// gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par// khros pas gzhan la btsog pa dang*// theg pa chen po spongs byed cing*// dam chos 'drar snang ston pa 'o// zhes gsungs so// ci'i phyir de dag la pham pa dang 'dra ba zhes brjod ce na/

'dul ba las/ yan lag tshang ba'i srog gcod sogs kyis dge slong gi sdom pa pham par byed pas na/ pham par bzhag pa ltar/ (10) 'dir yang bdag bstod sogs bzhi po des/ sems bskyed pham par te nyams par byed pas na/ pham pa dang 'dra bar brjod do// kha cig rtsong 'di'i ya gyal so sor bsgrang nas brgyad du byed pa ni/ byang sems kyi sde snod dang 'gal te/ byang sar/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims kyi sdom pa la gnas pa'i pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi yod de/ bzhi gang zhe na/ zhes dang*/ sdom nyir/ de'i nyes pa bzhi po ni zhes dang*/ 'grel pa'i mtshams sbyor du/ nyes pa bzhi po de dag kyang gang yin zhe na/ zhes bzhir gsungs kyi brgyad du ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan du na dgur yang 'gyur ro// gnyis pa yan lag gi nyes byas ni/ nyes byas bzhi cu zhe drug ni/ dge ba chos bsdud dang 'gal ba so bzhi dang*/ sems can don byed dang 'gal ba bcu gnyis rnams su yod pa las/ dang po sbyin pa dang 'gal ba bdun ni/ dkon mchog gsum la gsum mi mchod// ces sogs dang*/ tshul khrims dang 'gal ba dgu ni/ tshul khrims 'chal pa yal bar 'dor// zhes sogs dang*/ bzod pa dang 'gal ba bzhi ni/ gshe la lan du gshe la sogs// zhes sogs dang*/ brtson 'grus dang 'gal ba gsum ni/ le lo la sogs sel mi byed// ces sogs dang*/ bsam gtan dang 'gal ba gsum ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don mi 'tshol// zhes sogs dang*/ shes rab dang 'gal ba brgyad ni/ nyan thos theg pa spong bar byed// ces sogs kyis bstan to// gnyis pa sems can don byed dang 'gal ba bcu gnyis ni/ dgos pa'i grogs su 'gro mi byed// ces sogs kyis bstan to// nyes byas zhe drug po 'di dag ni/ byang sar/ nyon mongs pa can gyi nyes pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa can min pa'i nyes pa dang*/ nyes med gsum du phye nas gsungs la/ gsum po de yang 'di'i 'grel par/

gal te ma gus pa dang snyoms las dang*/ le lo'i nyes pa byung na ni/ nyon mongs pa can gyi nyes par 'gyur ro// gal te brjed pas nyes pa byung na ni/ nyon mongs pa can min pa'i nyes par 'gyur ro// sems 'khrugs pa la ni nyes pa med do// zhes gsung*/ 'di dag gi don sdom nyi'i 'grel pa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa las rgyas par 'byung ngo*// 'o na lugs gnyis la/ rtsa ltung byung bas sdom pa gtong mi gtong mtshungs sam zhe na/ de'i khyad par ni/ chag lo'i dris lan las/ sdom pa gtong ba'i tshul yang*/ so so thar pa la'ang ltung ba byung bas/ sdom pa gtong ba dang mi gtong ba'i lugs gnyis gda'/ de bzhin du theg pa chen po la yang gnyis yod pa'i sems tsam pa ltung bas sdom pa gtong ba'i lugs su gsal/ dbu ma pa la lugs gnyis ka gda'/ nged cag smon pa'i sems ma btang na sdom pa'i rtsa ba mi gtong ba'i lugs de'i rjes su 'brang ba lags/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pas shes so// de la sems tsam pa ltung ba byung bas sdom pa gtong ba'i lugs su gsal/ zhes pa yang*/ kun dkris drag pos rtsa ltung byung ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ kun dkris 'bring dang chung ngus pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos spyad kyang sdom pa mi gtong bar 'dod de/ byang sa las/ mdor bsdus na rgyu gnyis kho nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag blang pa btang bar 'gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon pa yongs su btang ba dang*/ pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos kyi kun nas dkris pa chen po'i kun nas (11) spyod pa'o// byang chub sems dpa' gang gi smon lam yang ma btang la pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos rnams kyis kun nas dkris pas chen po yang*/ kun tu ma spyad na tshe brjes su zin kyang*/ 'og dang steng dang thad ka thams cad du skyes pa na/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang pa spong bar mi 'gyur ro// byang chub sems dpa' tshe brjes te/

brjed na yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa la brten nas dran pa bso ba'i phyir/ yang dang yang nod par zad kyi/ gsar du yang dag par len pa ni min no// zhes dang*/ pham pa'i gnas lta bu bzhi po 'di dag ni kun nas dkris pa chung ngu dang*/ 'bring gis ni tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang pa de byang chub kyi sems gtang bar mi 'gyur ro// kun nas dkris pa chen pos ni gtang bar 'gyur te/ zhes gsungs so// 'o na kun dkris chung ngu dang*/ 'bring dang*/ chen po'i khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/ byang sa las/ gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpas pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi po 'di dag rgyun ma chad pa kun tu spyod pa dang*/ ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ khrel yod pa chung ngu yang mi skyed pa dang*/ des mgu bar byed cing*/ de la dga' bar byed pa dang*/ de nyid la yon tan du blta ba can du gyur pa 'di ni kun nas dkris pa chen po yin par rig par bya'o// zhes gsung la/ yan lag gsum tshang ba chen por bstan pa'i shugs la yan lag gnyis tsam tshang ba 'bring dang*/ gcig tsam tshang ba chung ngur shes par bya'o// gnas brtan byang bzang gis sdom nyi'i 'grel par/ gang gis tshe slar ngo tsha dang*/ khrel cung zad tsam skye ba dang*/ pha rol gyi gsol ba btab pas zlog pa de ni 'bring la gnas pa'o// gang gis tshe myur ba nyid du ngo tsha bar byed cing*/ rang nyid kyang rung ste/ skad cig zlog pa de ni/ chung ngu la gnas par rig par bya'o// zhes gsung pa yin no// lugs gnyis kyi khyad par mdor bsdu na/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed la ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa'i sems mi nyams par bsrungs nas/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya la/ rang gi blo tshod dang sbyar nas ji tsam nus pa bsrung zhing*/ dus kyang zhag gcig dang*/ zla ba dang*/ lo dang ji srid 'tsho'i bar dang*/ byang chub kyi bar ji tsam blos len par nus pa de tsam blang bar bya ste/

bslab btus las/ sdom pa bdag nyid kyi stobs dang sbyar nas blang bar bya ste/ de lta min na/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten bslus par 'gyur ro// zhes gsung pa yin no// sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed la ni/ smon sems btang ba dang*/ kun dkris drag pos pham pa byung bas sdom pa btang zhing*/ bslab bya yang mtha' dag la slob pa dang*/ dus kyang byang chub kyi bar du len pa kho na gsungs kyi bslab bya so sor phye ba dang*/ dus yun ring thung gi rnam gzhag ma gsung pas lugs de dag ma 'dres par so sor shes par bya'o// cho ga'i lag len ni/ sems bskyed chen mo sogs na bzhugs/ 'di dag ni gzhung gi tshig don rgyas par phye ba yin la/ 'bru gnon tsam byed na gsung rab dgongs gsal nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ shin tu bsdus pa ni/ sngar gyi sbyor ba'i don tshang ngo*// gzhung gang dang gang gi tshig don rnam par bcad pa bsdus rgyas kyi tshul 'di lta bu yang dgongs par bzhugs 'tshal/ gnyis pa theg chen sems bskyed bye brag tu

(12) bshad pa la gsum ste/ ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i cho ga thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i bslab bya/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i thabs lam rnam dag tu bsgrub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ kun rdzob sems bskyed skye ba'i cho ga bshad pa/ don dam sems bskyed cho gas skye ba dgag pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ lugs gsum rten gyi khyad par lung gi bsgrub/ de nyid dpe yi sgo nas gsal bar bshad/ lung gi don la log par rtog pa dgag lugs gnyis cho ga'i khyad par so sor bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed skye ba'i yul nges par bstan/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kun la skye bar bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dngos kyi don dang*/ de la log par rtog pa'i tshul brjod pa/ de nyid lung dang rigs pas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ sems tsam pa yi/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ sems tsam pa yi sems bskyed kyi cho ga 'di bod na byed pa mang du yod mod kyi/ cho ga de ni su yang rung ba yi gang zag so thar gyi sdom pa med pa'i khyim pa dang*/ sdom pa yod kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mi shes pa dang*/ shes kyang bslab bya nyams 'og tu ma tshud pa'i 'gro ba rnams la byar mi rung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ la la skye bo zhes sogs rkang pa gsum ste/ bka' gdam gdams ngag pa la la/ skye bo 'ga' zhig ste stod lung du dge bshes phyag sor ba la sogs pa'i rmi lam du byams pa mgon po khri mthon po la bzhugs nas khrom chen po la sems bskyed mdzad par rmis pa'i rmi lam gyi ni rjes su 'brangs nas/ so thar gyi sdom pa thob pa dang ma thob pa'i sems can kun la sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed 'bogs par byed do// gsum pa ni/ rmi lam bdud kyi/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhi ste/ de ltar rmi lam gyi rjes su 'brang nas skye bo kun la sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed byed pa'i lugs de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa min te/

de lta bu'i rmi lam bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa min na de ltar rung yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi mthun pa'i thabs lam ston pa'i rmi lam bdud kyi byin rlabs yod pa'i phyir te/ mdo las/ bdud sdig can sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas nas chos log pa ston par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ thogs med kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang ni/ jo bo rje mar me mdzad kyis bkag pa'i phyir dang*/ de'i cho ga las kyang de ltar mi rung ba gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ byang sa'i tshul khrims le'ur/ rigs kyi bu khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ gnyis pa grub ste/ jo bo'i lam sgron du/ so so thar pa rigs bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min// zhes byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mi shes pa dang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa med pa la/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed bkag pa'i phyir/ lam sgron rang 'grel las/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i yan lag tu gyur pa yin te/ phyogs gcig nyid du shes par bya'o// de'i phyir so so thar pa'i sdom pa bzhin dang ldan pa 'dis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par len pa'i snod du gyur pa la bslab pa'i tshigs 'di yang sbyin par bya/ zhes pa'i don to zhes dang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa yang dag med na gcig shos lta ga la yod du rung*/ zhes dang*/ de lta bas na so so thar pa'i sdom pa de dang por dgos shing sngon du 'gro ba nyid do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed len pa'i (13) gang zag yin na/ so thar rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan pas ma khyab pa'i dmigs gsal dgos te/ theg pa chen por rigs bsad pa dang*/

skye ba gzhan du theg pa chen po la gom par byas pa la/ rigs bdun gang rung med kyang dang po nyid du sems bskyed skye ste/ rang 'grel las/ yang na rigs la gnas pa dang skye ba gzhan du theg pa chen po la gom par byas pa la ni/ rang bzhin gyi sdig pa mi spyod par byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa de nyid dang po nyid du blangs kyang nyes pa med do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// mkhas pa kha cig de'i rten du rigs bdun gang rung dgos par gsung pa rten khyad par can gyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ de nges par dgos pa min te/ rang 'grel las/ da ni tshul khrims kyi sdom pa'i rten khyad par can bstan par 'dod nas/ so so thar pa rigs bdun gyi// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhed de/ yang kha cig sems bskyed kyi rten du so thar ldan pa ni ma dag pa'i rten dang*/ de ltar mi dgos pa ni dag pa'i rten du 'dod de/ rang 'grel las/ khyod kyis dang por de ni skyes bu mchog yin no// sems can dam pa byang chub mchog 'dod par 'gyur pa de dag la zhes ma smras la/ yang 'dir 'di skad du brjod pa de ji lta bu smras pa bden te/ snga ma ni ma dag pa'i rten du bzhag la/ 'di ni dag pa'i rten du 'dod pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bzhed mod/ spyir btang dmigs bsal yin pas 'gal ba med do// sems bskyed 'bog pa'i cho ga las kyang de ltar du gsung ste/ byang sar rigs kyi bu'am/ chos kyi yul can ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ zhes smros shig des kyang legs so zhes khas longs shig ces gsung pa'i phyir ro// de la bka' gdam pa kha cig sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed byed pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod shes pa dang*/ so thar gyi sdom pas rgyud gdam pa dgos kyang*/ skye bo kun la byed pa mi 'gal te/ gang zag blun po sdig pa can yin yang sems bskyed kyi gral der 'tshogs pa thams cad ni/

so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa can dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo la mkhas pa sha stag yin no zer lo// de ni mi 'thad de/ so thar gyi sdom pa med kyang yod ces zer ba dang*/ byang sems kyi sde snod la mi mkhas kyang mkhas pa sha stag yin zer ba 'di 'dra'i rdzun gyi tshig la'ang bden par 'dzin pa yod pas sems so na yod pa dang*/ lung rigs la mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzun tshig 'di la legs par dpyod cig gal te 'di 'dra ba'i rdzun gyi tshig bden na tshig de las mi bden pa'i rdzun tshig can ci zhig yod de med pa des na chos kyi rjes su 'brangs ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyis sems tsam lugs kyi 'jug pa'i sems bskyed khrom chen po la byed pa'i lugs 'di spongs shig ces gdams pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi sems bskyed/ ces sogs rkang pa bcu gcig ste/ 'o na dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi rten la yang so thar rigs bdun gang rung blang pa dang*/ sde snod kyi ma mo shes pa sogs dgos sam zhe na/ mi dgos te/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed 'di ni/ cho ga'i brda 'phrod cing len 'dod yod pa'i sems can kun gyis legs par thob pa ste/ blang na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhes theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs pa'i phyir te/ de yang mdo las gsung pa ni/ sdong po bkod pa dang*/ mdo sde skal bzang dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang*/ rgyal po la gdam pa yi mdo sde dang*/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i zhus pa'i mdo la sogs pa rnams su ltos te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis grong khyor skyid pa'i 'byung (14) gnas kyi shar phyogs nags tshal pa la sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar/ chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan pas/

rgya mtsho'i klu stong phrag bcu bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to zhes dang*/ skal bzang las/ rgyal ba phan bzhed grong dpon gyur pa'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'od de la// nyin gcig srog gcod sdom pa blang nas kyang*// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// zhes dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las/ byang sems rgyal po la lnga dang*/ blon po la lnga/ las dang po pa la brgyad de/ rang sar 'byung nye bas rten gyi sgo nas dbye ba bco brgyad gsung pa dang*/ dkon brtsegs kyi gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa'i mdo las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su dag pa 'di bstan pa na/ 'khor de'i nang nas lha dang*/ mi'i srog chags khri nyis stong bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do// zhes dang*/ rgyal po la gdam pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po 'di ltar khyod ni/ bya ba mang ba/ byed pa mang ba/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub kyi tshogs kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur to// zhes dang*/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ klu khri nyis stong gis byang chub tu sems bskyed/ ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis ngan song gi gnas rnams su byon te/ ngan song pa de dag bden pa mthong ba la bkod ces sogs theg chen gyi mdo sde du ma las gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bstan bcos las gsung ste/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rin chen 'phreng bar/ sems can thams cad byang chub tu// sems bskyed bcug cing brtan byas nas// ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan pa'i// byang chub sems dang rtag ldan 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos bslab btus su/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo drangs te/ g.yo rgyus sems bskyed pa yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyur gsung na/ dge ba sna 'ga' byas te/ sems can sems bskyed pa lta ci smos zhes pa la sogs pa theg chen gyi bstan bcos rnams las gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/

ji ltar 'bras kyi/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ 'o na sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi yul nges pa dang*/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed sems can kun la skye ba'i dpe ji ltar yin zhe na/ de'i dpe yod de/ 'bras kyi sa bon ni/ grang ba'i yul du mi skye la/ dpe de bzhin du/ sems tsam pa yi yang sems bskyed so thar gyi sdom pa dang mi ldan pa'i rang bzhin gyi sdig pa can la mi skye ba dang*/ ji ltar nas kyi sa bon ni/ yul grang dro gang du'ang skye ba ltar/ dpe de bzhin du/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi sems bskyed kyang*/ rang bzhin gyi sdig pa chen po yod pa dang*/ de med pa'i sems can kun la skye ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ gal te mdo las/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gcig ste/ gal te sngar drangs pa'i mdo skal bzang las/ sems can thams cad la sems bskyed skye bar bshad pa yi rgyal ba phan bzhed zhes sogs kyi gzhung de/ dbu ma par ma zad sems tsam pa yi yang lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi lung du ci 'gal te mi 'gal bar thal/ gzhung der so thar rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan pa'i rten la sems bskyed mdzad par bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'thad snyam na/ de ltar 'dod pa ni 'khrul pa yin te/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems skye ba'i rten la so thar rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan pa gcig dgos shing*/ (15) skal bzang las/ sngon rgyal ba phan bzhed grong dpon du gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'od kyi drung du/ nyin gcig gi bar srog gcod tsam spong ba'i sdom pa blangs pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed 'bogs par mdzad la/ nyin gcig gi srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa de ni so so thar pa rigs bdun gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ de la sogs pa so thar rigs bdun gang rung gi rten du mi rung ba'i lha dang klu la sogs pa la sems bskyed mdzad pa gong du drang pa'i mdo bstan bcos kyi 'thad pa rnams dbu ma pa'i lugs la 'thad pa yin mod kyi/

sems tsam pa yi lugs la 'thad pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ des na sems tsam/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu ste/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed skye ba'i yul nges pa des na/ gal te sems tsam pa yi lugs kyi sems bskyed de len par 'dod na thog mar so so thar pa rigs bdun gang yang rung ba longs/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod byang sa lta bu la slob/ de'i bslab bya la dad cing sgrub par nus par gyur na phyis nas 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa long ste/ byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u dang*/ gnas brtan byang bzang sogs kyis len tshul gyi rim pa de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir ro// rgyu mtshan ci ste sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi sa bon theg chen sems bskyed 'jog par 'dod na/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga 'khrul pa med pa'i sgo nas dbu ma pa yi gzhung spyod 'jug dang*/ yi dam blang pa'i cho ga bzhin du gyis te/ gzhung de dag las/ brda 'phrod cing len 'dod yod pa'i sems can kun la sems bskyed skye bar bshad pa de dbu ma pa'i lugs la sgrub byed tshad ma yin pa'i phyir ro// ༈ //dbu ma'i lugs kyi sems bskyed 'di zhes sogs la yang mkhas pa chen po kha cig gis/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi// rten du so thar mi dgos na// yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro bar// gsung pa'i dgongs pa gang zhig yin// zhes pa'i lan/ kun mkhyen gyis/ dbu ma lugs dang*/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed la so thar sngon du 'gro mi dgos pa dang*/ dgos pa'i khyad par gsung pa ni/ lugs de'i sems bskyed kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga'i sngon du so thar gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa mi dgos pa dang dgos pa'i khyad par yin gyi/ sems bskyed kyi dngos gzhi la sbyor ba'i skabs su so thar len pa mi dgos pa dang*/ dgos pa'i khyad par min te/

sbyor ba'i skabs su gnyis ka la yang thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa len par ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro// dper na skal dman rim 'jug pa dang*/ skal ldan cig char ba gnyis la/ dbang bskur gyi sngon du sdom pa 'og ma gnyis 'gro mi dgos pa dang*/ dgos pa'i khyad par yang*/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga'i sngon du yin gyi/ dbang gi dngos gzhi'i sngon du sta gon dang 'jug pa'i skabs su sdom pa 'og ma gnyis len pa yod pa la khyad par med pa bzhin no// des na rje btsun chen pos/ rgyun bshags kyi dus su nyes spyod spong ba'i tshul khrims skye zhing de nyid kyang*/ so so thar par bshad de ci// zhes pa'i lan yang snga ma de nyid kyis gsal bar bstan cing rang la gnod pa'i tshul snang ba ni 'og tu 'chad do// so so thar pa rigs bdun po// sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi// rten du dgos na rje btsun gyis// de dag de yi rten min par// gsung pa'i dgongs pa gang du bstsal// zhes pa'i lan ni/ rje btsun gyis de ltar gsung pa gtan med de/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭīkkar/ byang sa nas gsung pa (16) ltar/ 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sbyor ba'i skabs su/ so so thar pa'i sdom pas bsdam mam zhes dri ba mdzad par bzhed pa'i phyir ro// sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭīkkar/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa byang sems kyi sdom pa skye ba dang gnas pa gnyis ka'i rten du mi rung bar rgyu mtshan dang bcas te spyir mang du gsung pa ni/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so so thar pa rigs bdun la dgongs te/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong du yang de nyid kyi dogs pa bkod nas/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so so thar pa 'di skye ba dang gnas pa gnyis ka'i rten du mi rung bar khyed smra ba bzhin du/ kho bo cag kyang smra'o// zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes 'byung ngo*// 'khrul spong la gsung pa ni 'di yin te/

so so thar pa'i sdom pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob pa'i rten du mi rung ste/ so so thar pa ni gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med min pa gzhan la mi skye la/ byang chub kyi sems ni 'gro ba mtha' dag la skye bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang gnas pa'i rten du yang mi 'thad de/ so so thar pa ni shi nas gtong la/ byang chub sems dpa' ni ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du mi gtong ba'i phyir ro// zhe na/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so so thar pa 'di ni thob pa dang gnas pa'i rten du mi rung bar khyed smra ba bzhin du kho bo cag kyang smra'o// zhes so// gnyis pa don dam sems bskyed cho gas skyes pa dgag pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ don dam sems bskyed ces sogs rkang pa gsum ste/ phag gru/ 'bri/ stag bka' gdam pa kha cig don dam sems bskyed cho ga las thob par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung las bshad pa'i don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba ni/ tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs su bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bskal pa grangs med gcig tu bsgom pa'i stobs kyis/ sa dang por rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rang gi ngang gis skye ba la 'jog pa yin te/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de lta yin mod kyi/ cho ga'i sgo nas don dam sems bskyed 'di mi skye ste/ de la 'og nas 'chad pa'i lung rigs rnams kyis gnod pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ cho gas skye ba la gnod byed bstan/ cho gas skye ba'i sgrub byed med/ cho gas mi skye ba dpe'i sgo nas sgrub/ de la lung dang 'gal ba spang ba'o// dang po ni/ gal te cho gas/

zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ gal te don dam sems bskyed cho ga'i sgo nas skye na skyon ni ci zhig yod snyam na/ don dam sems bskyed 'di ni chos can/ khyod rags pa brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed du 'gyur bar thal/ khyod cho ga las thob pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod don dam chos nyid bsgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa zhes bya ba'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ 'di la sbyor dngos zhes sogs rkang pa drug te/ don dam sems bskyed cho ga las thob pa'i bsgrub byed med de/ don dam sems bskyed 'di la thob byed sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga rgyal bas gsung pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ klu sgrub dang*/ dbyig gnyen la sogs mkhas pa thams cad don dam sems bskyed 'di la thob byed kyi cho ga mi mdzad cing*/ rgya la mdzad kyang sangs rgyas kyis ma gsung pas cho ga yang dag par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// rgyu mtshan des na don dam sems bskyed la cho ga byed pa 'di 'dra ba'i rigs can kun sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam yin gyi/ bstan

(17) pa rnam par dag pa ma yin pas spangs bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ dper na chu lud/ ces sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ don dam sems bskyed cho ga'i sgo nas mi skye ba dang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga'i sgo nas skye ba'i dpe yod de/ dper na zhing la chu lud 'grem pa dang*/ sa bon 'debs pa sogs kyi so nam skyes bu zhing pas dngos su bya bar nus kyi/ myu gu dang sdong bu snye ma la sogs pa zhing las dngos su 'byung gi zhing pa'i mi las dngos su 'byung ba ma yin pa de bzhin du/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rang rgyu cho ga'i sgo nas dngos su bskyed nus kyi theg pa chen po'i mthong lam sogs don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang ni zag pa med pa'i sdom pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi ni sdom pa la sogs sogs zhes pa'i thad du/ rang mchan dang 'dres pa'i mchan snying zhig las/ khong nas dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po rnams bsgom pas skye yi cho gas mi skye gsung*/ zhes pa snang*/ pa bsgom pa'i stobs kyis ngang gis skye yi/ cho ga'i sgo nas skye ba min pa'i phyir ro// tshul 'di dag 'thad pa dang bcas pa/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun las 'byung ste/ kā ma la shī la'i bsgom rim du/ dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdo drangs pa las/ don dam byang chub kyi sems de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa/ spros pa mtha' dag bral ba shin tu gsal ba/ don dam pa'i spyod yul dri ma med pa/ mi g.yo ba rlung med pa'i mar me'i rgyun bzhin du mi g.yo ba'o// de 'grub pa ni/ rtag tu gus pas zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong gi rnal 'byor gom pa las 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ klu sgrub kyi byang chub sems 'grel las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems// bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma sgrib pa// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid 'dod// snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis ni// 'bad de bsgom par bya ba nyid// ces pa dang*/

yang de nyid las/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// ༈ //'dir paṇḍi ta kha cig don dam sems bskyed bya ba yi// cho ga rgyal bas ma gsung na// 'phags pa la klu sgrub skyob nyid kyis// byang chub sems 'grel zhes bya ba'i// bstan bcos dag las gsung de ci// zhes pa'i lan/ kun mkhyen gyi/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub sems 'grel las/ kun rdzob sems bskyed cho gas blang nas/ don dam sems bskyed bsgom pa'i stobs kyis skye dgos pas bsgom tshul bshad pa tsam zhig snang gi cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed pa mi snang ste/ de nyid las/ byang chub kyi sems chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ji ltar sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems chen po bskyed par bgyis te/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o// de ltar byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa ni smon lam gyi rang bzhin kun rdzob kyi snang ba'o// byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis don dam pa yang bsgom pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya'o// da ni de'i rang bzhin 'chad par byed de/ byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang rgyud nas// srid pa 'joms (18) par byed pa yi// byang chub sems bsgom bdag gis bshad// byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid du// bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma sgrib cing*// stong par sangs rgyas rtag tu bzhed// ces gsung zhing*/

'gos 'gyur dang*/ pa tshab 'gyur las/ byang chub sems dpa' la sngags kyi spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis de ltar kun rdzob kyi rnam pas byang chub kyi sems smon pa'i rang bzhin can bskyed nas/ zhes sogs gsungs so// kun rdzob sems bskyed cho gas blang pa'i rjes su/ don dam sems bskyed bsgom pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par byang chub sems 'grel las 'di ltar gsung*/ zhes sogs 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ don dam sems bskyed bya'o// zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gcig ste/ kha cig don dam sems bskyed la cho ga med na/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pa/ dus 'di nas bzung nas nam byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ gzung ba dang*/ 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin sems thog ma nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de ltar bdag gis kyang byang chub tu sems bskyed do// zhes lan gsum brjod par gsung pa dang*/ dpa' bskong phyag rgya pa las/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ nam byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi ste/ bdag nyid lus 'bul gyi thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ so so nas rtag tu bzhes shing ji ltar na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched kyis ma zin pa/ chos thams cad bdag med pa dang mnyam pa/ thog ma med pa nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa ltar/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pas kyang*/

dus 'di nas bzung ste/ nam byung chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes dang*/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga las kyang*/ slob ma bzang po skal ldan man ngag thob// thal sbyar lag pa me tog 'dzin pa yis// byang chub sems ni don dam zhes bya ba// bla ma la ni slar yang blang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ gzhung de dag las/ don dam sems bskyed bya'o zhes gal te rgya la gsung srid kyang*/ don dam sems bskyed bzung ba dang*/ bsgom par dam bca' ba yin gyi/ de cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed pa min pa'i phyir dang*/ dpa' bskong ni bod du gnam babs su byung ba yin gyi rgya gar nas ma yin pas paṇḍi ta rnams rtsis su byed pa dka' 'o// de dag dam pa'i tshig yin pa dper na/ sbyin pa gtang bar bya/ tshul khrims dam pa bsrung bar bya/ sangs rgyas yon tan bsgrub par bya/ de la sogs pa so thar gyi mdo la/ brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya// sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya// 'dam bu'i khyim las glang chen bzhin// 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya// zhes gsung pa kun dam bca' ba'i tshig tsam nyid yin gyi/ don de dag cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed pa min pa bzhin no// de dag kyang cho ga yin na gnas ga ge mo zhig tu 'gro bar bya'o// zhes sogs cho ga ha cang thal bar (19) 'gyur gyi/ cho ga yang ni thug med du 'gyur te/ dam bca' ba'i tshig rnams cho ga yin pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ skye ma 'jig rten/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig te/ skye ma 'jig rten blun po mi mkhas pa 'di dag gis rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyis gsung pa'i sdom gsum gyi cho ga rnam dag kun bor nas/ ma gsung pa'i don dam sems bskyed la cho ga nan gyis tshang ba 'di 'dra ba ni/ bde 'gro dang*/ ngan 'gro cir 'gyur brtags te spang bar bya dgos so// ༈ //don dam sems bskyed cho gas mi skye bar gsung pa dang*/ mkhas pa kha cig shāka

sarba yo ga tsitta sogs// slob mas bzlas pas kun rdzob dang*// don dam sems bskyed 'dzin bcug nas// su ra ti sa ma zhes sogs kyis// skyes zin brtan par mdzad de ci// zhes pa'i lan/ kun mkhyen gyis/ spyir bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ sems bskyed de cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed na/ cho ga de las sems bskyed de skye dgos pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la/ kun rdzob sems bskyed la cho ga yod pa dang*/ don dam sems bskyed la cho ga med par bzhed la/ rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa'i rgyud sde 'ga' zhig las/ rgyun bshags kyi skabs su don dam byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bya'o// zhes sogs kyi tshig yod pa rnams ni/ dam bca' tsam yin gyi cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed pa min par/ bstan bcos 'dir sbyin pa gtang bar bya// tshul khrims bsrung bar bya// zhes sogs kyi dpe dang*/ thub pa dgongs gsal las/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya'o// zhes sogs kyis/ dpe'i sgo nas gsal bar gsungs pa nges na/ dogs pa 'di lta bu'i gzhi med do// gzhan du na/ sarba yo ga sogs slob mas 'das ma thag tu slob ma des theg pa chen po'i mthong lam thob par 'gyur te/ don dam sems bskyed skyes pa'i phyir ro// zhes sogs gsung pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi skabs su'ang mkho bar gda' 'o// gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i bslab bya la gnyis te/ ltung ba'i rnam gzhag mu bzhir bstan pa dang*/ bslab bya'i gtso bo la log rtog dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mu bzhir dbye ba dang*/ bzhir 'gyur ba'i 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar sems tsam zhes sogs rkang pa bco lnga te/ 'o na lugs gnyis kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga'i khyad par de ltar yin na/ bslab bya'i khyad par ji lta bu snyam na/ sngar bshad pa de ltar/ sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma pa gnyis sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga sogs kyi rnam gzhag tha dad du yod mod kyi/

'on kyang theg chen dbu sems kun mthun par ltung ba'i rnam gzhag mu bzhi gsungs te/ ltung ba med pa dang*/ ltung ba dang*/ ltung ba yi gzugs brnyan dang*/ ltung ba med pa yi gzugs brnyan zhes bya ba rnam pa bzhir gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bzhi po gang zhe na/ de dag gi mtshan nyid yod de/ sems bskyed dang ldan pas bsam pa dag pa dge ba'i kun nas blang ste/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ tshul khrims bsrung ba sogs ni/ rnam pa kun tu ltung ba med pa dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa zhe sdang sogs kyis kun nas blangs te gzhan gyi srog gcod pa dang*/ ma byin par len pa sogs/ rnam pa kun tu ltung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ dge ba'i sems kyis kun nas blangs te sems can sad pa dang*/ ma byin par len pa sogs ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan yin zhes gsungs te/ ded dpon snying rje chen po/ mi nag mdung thung can bsad pa lta bu'o// gzhan la gnod na rdzun ma yin par tshig drang por smra yang (20) ltung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan yin te/ dper na dgra sha len pa'i skye bos/ gsad yul de gar song 'dri na 'di na'o zhes smra ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ mdor na sems kyi/ zhes sogs rkang pa dgu ste/ de dag gi 'thad pa yod de/ kun slong dang lus ngag gi sbyor ba gnyis ka gnag pa ltung ba dang*/ de gnyis ka dkar ba ltung med dang*/ kun slong dkar na sbyor ba gnag kyang ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan yin gyi don la ltung med yin pa dang*/ kun slong gnag na sbyor ba dkar yang ltung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan yin gyi don la ltung ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mdor bsdu na/ kun slong sems kyis 'phen pa las gzhan pa'i theg pa chen po'i dge sdig yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha yi bzhi brgya par/ kun slong bsam pa yi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa' yi lus ngag gi dge ba'am/ yang na mi dge bar snang ba thams cad dge ba nyid du 'gyur gyi gzhan du min te/

rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na byang chub sems dpa'i las dge sdig la kun slong gi sems de gtso bo'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ der ma zad/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun las kyang*/ dge sdig gi rnam gzhag sems la rag las pa de ltar du gsungs te/ dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las/ dge ba'am 'on te mi dge ba'i// las kyi sems ni bsags pa yin// zhes dang*/ chos yang dag par bsdud pa'i mdo las/ chos thams cad kyang sems la rag las pa yin no// zhes dang*/ slob dpon nag po pas/ dgra nag gi 'grel par rgyud kyi lung drang pa las/ mchog gsum yon tan rig par 'gyur// bdud rtsi yid 'ong 'khor bas dga'// 'bras bu nges par legs par thob// de phyir dam pa'i zhal nas ni// gsung ba'i bya ba sdig kyang bya// dam pa'i zhal nas ma gsung pa'i// dge ba'ang mkhas pas spang bar bya// zhes gsung pa dang*/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong las/ dge slong rang bzhin pha rgan la// myur ldong zhes ni bskul gyur na// phul bas de ni shi gyur kyang*// mtshams med sbyor ba ma yin no// bsam pa bzang pos 'chil lham gnyis// thub pa'i dbu la bzhag pa dang*// de ni gzhan gyi bsal byas pa// gnyis kas rgyal srid thob par 'gyur// de phyir bsam pa'i rtsa ba la// bsod nams sdig pa rnam par gnas// zhes dang*/ dbyig gnyen gyis kyang las grub par/ lus ngag gi las rnam par rig byed dang*/ rig byed ma yin pa gzugs can ni/ dge ba dang mi dge ba mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ lus bor nas tshe phyi ma la 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba dang*/ mi 'ong ba 'grub pa de dge ba dang mi dge ba yin par 'chad pa'i phyir ro// las ni sems dpa'i khyad par ro// zhes sogs gsung pas so// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bslab bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i log rtog brjod/ de nyid rigs pas rnam par brtags nas dgag bslab bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa'o// dang po ni/

byang chub sems kyi bslab pa la// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ byang chub sems kyi bslab pa la bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang*/ brje ba bsgom pa'i tshul gnyis su gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa ni// dang po nyid du 'bad de bsgom// bde dang sdug bsngal mnyam pas na// thams cad bdag bzhin bsrung bar bya// zhes dang*/ gang phyir bdag dang gzhan gnyis ka /myur du skyob par 'dod pa des// bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba// gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya// zhes gsungs so// de la 'bri (21) khung pa kha cig dgongs gcig tu rdo rje'i gsung*/ rang gzhan brjes pas nyes par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod bya ba bzhugs/ des na rang gzhan brje ba bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa ma yin te/ rje rin po che rtag par zhabs snyung ngam/ mi bde ba ci lags/ zhes 'jig rten mgon pos zhus pas/ kho bo sngon dad pa ni che/ shes rab ni chung bas/ rtag par gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa de mtha' btsan pas da lta rtag par zhabs snyung ba des lan/ zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang bdag cag las rgyud tshod cung zad mtho bas bzod dam snyam na/ 'phags pa sha ri'i bu/ sa drug pa ba gcig yin pa la dus la ma bab par/ mig sbyin par btang bas nyan thos kyi sar ltung ba'i rkyen du gyur gyi/ des na sa brgyad pa yan chad ma gtogs pa de man chad bdag gzhan brjes na nyes par 'gyur bas na/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom du mi rung zhes su smra'o// de'i rgyu mtshan dris pas 'di skad lo// bdag gi bde ba gzhan la byin nas ni/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag gis blang par gyur na/ smon lam mtha' ni btsan pa'i phyir/ bdag ni dus rtag tu sdug bsngal dang bcas par 'gyur/ rgyu mtshan des na bdag gzhan brje ba 'di 'dra'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i gang zag de dag thabs la mi mkhas pas nor ba chen po'i chos lugs yin no lo/

zhes pa ma rang pa'i tshig yin no// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bsgrub bya la brtags nas dgag pa/ sgrub byed la brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ de don 'di ltar/ zhes sogs rkang pa dgu ste/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom du mi rung zer ba de'i don 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems de dge ba yin nam/ sdig pa yin brtag gal te de dge ba yin zer na ni/ de bsgom pa la sdug bsngal 'byung ba 'gal bar thal/ de 'dra'i sems de dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ sdig pa yin zer na/ de bsgom pa dug gsum gyis bskyed pa'i las su thal bar 'gyur te/ sems de sdig pa yin pa'i phyir na'o// de la ma khyab na sems de bsgom pa la sdug bsngal ga la 'byung ste mi 'byung bar thal/ de ltar brjes na bsgom pa dug gsum gyis bskyed pa'i las ma yin pas so// gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gsum ste/ khyod kyi smon lam mtha' btsan pa'i gtan tshigs mi 'grub ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong ba'i smon lam 'ga' zhig mtha' mi btsan pa'i phyir/ gal te btsan na/ ded dpon 'dza' bo'i bu dus rgyun du klad nad chen po dang bcas par 'gyur te/ des sems can thams cad kyi klad nad bdag la smin par smon lam btab pa gang zhig smon lam de mtha' btsan pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma khas blangs/ 'dod mi nus te/ dpe de ltar btab pas klad nad las grol te/ lhar skyes nas mthar sangs rgyas par mdo las gsung pa'i phyir/ ji ltar gsung na/ mdo drin lan bsab pa las/ sngon wā ra na sir/ ded dpon 'dza' bo zhes pa'i bu byung ngo cog shi nas/ phyis gcig skyes pa la/ 'dza' bo'i bu mor ming btags te/ pha rgya mtshor nor bu len du phyin pas shi nas/ ches skyes pa na/ pha'i las gang yin dris pa las/ drang por smras na/ rgya mtshor shir dogs nas 'bru tshong pa yin zhes smras

(22) pas karsha pa ni bzhi rnyed/ de bzhin du spos 'tshong pas brgyad/ gos kyis bcu drug dang*/ gser dngul tshong pas so gnyis brnyed pa thams cad ma la phul/ de nas tshong pa de'i rigs can rnams kyis/ khyod kyi pha rgya mtshor nor bu len pa'i rigs can yin no zhes smras pas/ dril bsgrags te/ tshong pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig chas pa la/ mas ma bzod par sgo la 'phred la bcad de nyal bas ma'i mgo la rdog pas snun te song ngo*// de nas rgya mtshor zhugs pas gru bo che chu srin nya mid kyis bcom nas zhig 'dza' bo'i bu mos gru shing tshal la 'jus nas mthar phyin pas/ grong khyer myos byed du lha'i bu mo bzhi dang*/ rta spyod du brgyad/ dga' byed du bcu drug tshangs pa'i bla mar so gnyis dang 'phrad de/ lo grangs du mar dga' bde myong*/ yang lho phyogs su song ba dang*/ lcags kyi khang pa chen po zhig mthong te/ 'gro 'dod par gyur nas nang du phyin pa dang*/ sgo rang 'grig tu song ngo*// nang na nam zhig lcags kyi 'khor lo me 'bar ba mgo la 'khor ba zhig mthong nas dris pas/ ma'i mgo la rdog pa rnun pa'i rnam smin no zer ba dang*/ rang gi de dran te/ nga yang las kyi 'dir khrid do snyam pa dang*/ nam mkha' las gang la bcing pa de dag 'chings shig bcing pa de dag grol cig zhes pa'i sgra thos pas/ 'khor lo de rang mgo la 'khor bar gyur to// 'dir gzhan yang yod med dris pas/ gang ma'i mgo la rdog pas bsnun pa thams cad 'dir 'ong ngo zhes zer ba dang*/ gzhan gces 'dzin gyi snying rje tshad med skyes te/ 'di lta bu'i myong nges kyi las bsags pa thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig gzhan su yang 'dir 'ong bar ma gyur cig ces brjod ma thag snying rje'i stobs kyis 'dza' bo'i bu mo'i mgo la 'khor ba'i 'khor lo de shing rta la bdun srid tsam du 'phags nas tshe'i dus byas te/ dga' ldan du skyes so// zhes gsungs so// kha cig 'dza' bo'i bu mo'i bu zer ba ni mdo dang mi mthun pas mi 'thad do// der ma zad dus gsum gyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/

dus rgyun du sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ de ltar brjes pa'i yul gyi sems can de dag kun la sdug bsngal 'byung ba srid par mi 'gyur bar thal/ de dag sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bde ba la longs spyod pa'i phyir te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sngon slob pa'i gnas skabs su bdag gzhan brje ba'i sems bsgom pa ni gang zhig de ltar bsgom pa'i smon lam mtha' btsan pa'i phyir ro// bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems bsgom du mi rung bar 'dod pa la/ lung rigs kyi gnod byed brjod zin pa des na/ brje ba'i byang sems bsgom pa nor pa chen po'i chos lugs yin zer ba/ 'di 'dra'i gsang tshig ni bdud kyi byin rlabs yin pa blun po phal cher gyis mi shes so ste shes nas spang bar bya'o// thabs phyin ci log tu ston pa thabs la bslu ba'i bdud yod ces rgyal bas gsung pa'ang dran par bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba la// sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i// bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa bslab bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i sgrub byed 'god (23) pa ni/ yid ches pa'i lung gis bsgrubs/ bsgom pa'i phan yon gyis bsgrubs/ ma bsgom pa'i nyes dmigs kyis bsgrubs/ des grub pa'i don bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ klu sgrub kyis lung gis bsgrubs/ zhi ba lha'i lung gis bsgrubs/ mdo dang bstan bcos gzhan gyis lung gis bsgrubs pa'o// dang po ni/ bdag gzhan brje ba/ zhes sogs bcu bdun te/ brje ba'i byang sems bsgom pa 'thad pa yin te/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems bsgom pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa chen po'i bstan pa'i snying po yin par gsung pa'i phyir/ sus gsung na/ 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhan sdug bsngal las skyob par mdzad pa nyid kyis rgyal po la gtam bya ba rin po che'i phreng bar 'di skad du gsungs te/

bdag la sems can de dag gi sdig pa dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal smin cing*/ bdag gi dus gsum du bsags shing sgo gsum dang 'brel ba'i dge ba dang*/ 'bras bu bde ba ma lus pa sems can de dang der smin par shog dus ji srid 'khor ba las sems can 'ga' zhig kyang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub gang du ma grol ba de srid du/ sems can de byang chub kyi bde ba mchog la 'god pa de'i phyir bdag gi bla na med pa yi byang chub thob kyang srid par gnas par gyur cig ces de skad brjod pa las byung ba'i bsod nams 'di/ rgyal gal te de ni gzugs can du gyur pa yin na/ chu bo gaṅgā'i bye ma'i rdul gyi grangs rnyed kyi ni 'jig rten gyi khams su bshong bar mi 'gyur ro// 'di klu sgrub kyi rang bzo yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ de lta bu'i bsod nams kyi tshad gzhal du med pa 'di ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bskang nas// de ni de las lhag par 'gyur// zhes gsung pas so// de ltar gsungs pa drang don yin no snyam na/ nges don yin pa'i gtan tshigs kyang ni don 'di la snang ste/ rin chen phreng bar/ phyogs rnams kun tu nam mkha' dang*// sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// ji ltar mtha' yas de bzhin du// sdug bsngal sems can mtha' yas 'dod// sems can mtha' yas de dag ni// byang chub sems dpa' snying rje bas// sdug bsngal dag las drang byas te// sangs rgyas nyid la 'god par nges// de ltar brtan par gnas de ni// mi nyal ba 'am nyal yang rung*// yang dag blangs pa nas bzung ste// zag med gyur kyang sems can rnams// mtha' yas phyir na sems can bzhin// bsod nams mtha' yas rtag sogs 'gyur// mtha' yas des na sangs rgyas nyid// mtha' yas thob mi dka' zhes bya// zhes pa de la sogs pa legs par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/

spyod 'jug las kyang zhes sogs rkang pa drug ste/ ā tsarya nā ga dzu na slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gsung par ma zad/ ā tsarya shānti de wa slob dpon zhi ba lhas spyod pa la 'jug pa las kyang 'di skad du/ bdag gi bde ba dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag yang dag par brje ba ma byas na/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing*/ 'khor ba na yang sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba'i skabs med ces de skad gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang spyi'ang rung*// de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba yis// 'gro ba bde la spyod par shog /ces gsung pa legs par gzung la bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la 'bad par bya'o// (24) gsum pa ni/ mdo dang bstan bcos zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis te/ spyod 'jug sogs las gsung par ma zad/ theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos gzhan du ma las kyang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi snying por bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems bsgom pa 'di gsungs pa yin te/ gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las/ gzhan yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thabs la mkhas pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ 'di ltar sems can de dag gi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad bdag gi lus la 'bab par gyur cig sems can de dag bde bar gyur cig ces pa dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'khor ba mthar thug bar du ni/ sems can sangs rgyas ma thob bar// zhes pa'ang snang*// bdag 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba yis// 'gro ba bde la spyod par shog /ces dang*/ mdo sde sems dpa' mchog las/ sems can dmyal rnams gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang*/ dud 'gro lha dang mi yi sdug bsngal dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phung po mtha' yas pa// bdag la bab gyur 'gro ba bde bar shog /ces dang*/

ba tsha'i chu rlung zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ sems can phan pa'i dbang du byas pa ngas ni bsgrub pa ste// sku 'di sems can don nyid kho nar bskyed pa la// bdag gi yid kyis kyang ni sems can dag la gnod byed na// de ni nga la ji ltar 'dren te bltos par yin// zhes dang*/ gang zhig de la 'tshe na des ni nga la rtses pa yin// sems can rnams la mchog tu phan de nga la mchod mchog yin// sems can rnams la gnod pa'i mchog ni nga la gnod mchog yin// nga dang sems can dag ni bde dang sdug bsngal mtshungs 'dod pas// gang zhig sems can gnod byed de ni nga la ji ltar smos// sems can sems can nga yis skyob pa snyam dang dge ba byas// sems can dag la brten nas don bsgrub pha rol phyin pa'ang thob// ces dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ bsam gtan bde ba dor nas kyang*// mnar med par yang 'jug par byed// 'di ni ngo 'tshar bsngags 'os so// 'di ni dam pa'i tshul lugs mchog /ces dang*/ slob dpon bhū ri pas/ sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin// bdag gi dge bas de kun bde thob shog /ces dang*/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i zhal nas kyang*// khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin// bdag gi bsod nams sems can khyer// zhes gsungs pas so// gnyis pa ni/ des na bdag gzhan/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ brje ba'i byang sems chos kyi snying por gsung pa des na/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul legs par shes pa'i skyes bu de ni myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ sangs ma rgyas pa de yi bar du 'jig rten gyi dge legs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i phan yon ldan par gsungs te/ mdo las/ byang chub kyi sems de ni dbul ba thams cad yang dag par gcod par byed pas rnam thos kyi bu lta bu'o// don thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu'o// bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o// nyon mongs pa'i dgra thams cad pham par byed pas mdung thung lta bu'o// tshul bzhin min pa yid la byed pa thams cad 'gems pas go cha lta bu'o// nyon mongs pa'i mgo ltung bar byed pas ral gri lta bu'o// 'tshe ba thams cad las skyob par byed pas mtshon cha lta bu'o// zhes dang*/

spyod 'jug (25) las/ mang du bshad lta ci zhig dgos// byis pa rang gi don byed dang*// thub pa gzhan gyi don mdzad pa// 'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par bltos// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ byang chub sems kyi/ zhes sogs rkang pa bco brgyad de/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems kyi gnad 'chugs na de las chos gzhan stong nyid bsgom pa dang*/ dge ba sangs rgyas su bsngo ba rnams kyis ni 'tshang mi rgya ste/ thabs mkhas byang chub sems dang bral ba'i stong nyid nyan thos rnams kyis bsgoms kyang*/ de yi 'bras bu dman pa'i 'gog pa tsam thob pa'i phyir dang*/ so so thar pa'i mdo las/ so so thar pa ston pa yi// bsod nams grub pa gang yod pa// de yis 'jig rten ma lus dang*// thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog /ces gsung pa bzhin du/ bsngo ba nyan thos rnams byed kyang 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par mi nus pa'i phyir ro// stong nyid nyan thos rnams bsgom pa'i sgrub byed yod de/ 'dul ba lung gi ka ta ya na la gdam pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ la sogs pa mdo sde las brgya dang*/ gang po'i rtogs brjod rnams su/ nyan thos kyi dgra bcom pa thob pa'i tshe/ stong pa nyid dang skye ba med pa dang nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mnyam pa dang*/ gser dang bong ba mnyam pa la sogs 'khor 'das kyi chos kun mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'ang gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'o na chos kun mnyam nyid du rtogs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thun mong min pa'i lam ma yin nam snyam na/ 'di la gang zag gi bdag dang*/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag dang*/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag gis stong pa'i mnyam pa nyid gsum las/ dang po gnyis nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyis rim pa bzhin rtogs pa'i dbang du byas pa mngon rtogs rgyan las bshad de/ gzung don rtog pa spongs phyir dang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyan las gsungs pa'i chos kyi bdag 'dzin ni/

'khor 'das la blang dor gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang*/ phung po stong pa nyid du 'dzin pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi chos la der 'dzin pa dang*/ byang phyogs so bdun la thar lam du 'dzin pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa sogs blang dor tha dad du 'dzin pa'i chags pa phra mo yin te/ de nyid las/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*// dus gsum rtogs pa'i chos rnams dang*// sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la// spyod pa'i dus de mi mthun rtogs// rgyal la sogs la chags pa smra// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan 'dzin de dag ni/ nyan rang gi lam du cung zad tsam yang spong bar mi nus te/ nyan rang gi rigs can de dag ni/ 'khor ba la spangs bya dang*/ myang 'das la blang byar byas nas lam bsgrub pa'i phyir ro// so so thar pa'i mdo bzhin du bsngo ba nyan thos rnams kyang byed pa'i sgrub byed yod de/ 'dul ba lung gi thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las/ bdag gis bram ze 'dod pa la// dga' bas shing rta 'di btang pas// dngos po thams cad btang nas ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /ces pa dang*/ dpal gyi sde'i rtogs brjod las/ bram ze dam pa gzugs bzang ba dang*// sdug pa'i phyug ma 'di long shig /sbyin pa 'di yis myur du ni// byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes de dag la sogs pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas su bsngo ba'ang mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar gsung pa 'on kyang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems sogs thabs la mkhas pa yi khyad par 'ga' zhig la ma gsungs pas/ stong rkyang bsgom pa sogs kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub par mi nus te/ mdo bsdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du ltung*// zhes dang*/ (26) rin chen phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des// byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//

༈ //bsngo ba nyan thos rnam kyang byed// ces pa la/ skabs 'dir ma hā chen po paṇḍi ta mkhas pa shākya mchog ldan pa'i zhal snga nas/ nyan thos rnams kyi rdzogs byang du// bsngo ba byed na 'phags pa yis// nyan thos theg pa de las ni// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad de// zhes gsung pa de gang la dgongs/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las// bsngo ba bshad de nyan thos kyi// bsngo ba yin par bzhed dam ci// zhes dri ba mdzad pa'i lan ni/ kun mkhyen puṇye sidhe bsod nams seng ge'i zhal snga nas/ dri ba po'i bsam pa blang pa dang*/ gsung rab spyi'i dgongs pa blang ste dpyad pa/ de bdag nyid chen po'i bzhed par bsgrubs pa dang*/ de lan rnam dag tu 'gyur pa'i tshul dang*/ bzhi las/ dang po ni/ 'dir/ so so thar pa'i mdo bzhin du// bsngo ba nyan thos rnams kyang byed// ces dang*/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las// bdag gis bram ze 'dod pa la// dga' bas shing rta 'di btang bas// dngos po thams cad btang nas ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /ces gsung pa de nyan thos kyi sde snod nas bshad pa'i bsngo bar gsungs pa dang*/ klu sgrub kyi rin chen phreng bar/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des// byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'gal lo snyam nas dri bar snang ste/ 'di ni bstan bcos 'di nyid du ma zad/ nyan thos kyi sde snod nas byang chub sems dpa'i bsngo ba bshad pa dang*/ klu sgrub kyi de ma bshad par gsungs pa gnyis la 'gal spong gsung rab 'chad pa po thams cad kyis dgongs pa rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i dri bar snang zhing*/ 'di bzhin dris pa la/ klu sgrub la rgol lo// sa paṇa la rgol lo// zhes sogs skyon 'dogs pa dag ni/ blun po'i rnam thar skyong ba yin no// so thar kyi skabs su/

sngar rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i dri ba yin zhes smras pa de dang*/ byang sems kyi skabs su/ 'di dang gnyis ni dogs pa skyes nas dri ba yang dkon na/ de'i lan tshul bzhin du smra ba yang dkon pa lta smos pa ci dgos/ gnyis pa ni/ spyir sde snod dang*/ grub 'thas phye ba'i theg pa che chung dang*/ lam dang 'bras bu'i phye ba'i theg pa che chung gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lang kar gshegs par/ chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum// rnam par shes pa brgyad nyid dang*// bdag med gnyis kyi nang du ni// theg chen mtha' dag 'dus par zad// ces gsungs pa'i brjod bya 'di dag khas mi len pa'i rang sde rnams ni nyan thos pa zhes bya ste/ mtshan gzhi ni/ nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'am/ de las gyes pa bco brgyad do// brjod bya de dag khas len pa ni/ theg pa chen po pa ste/ mtshan gzhi ni/ dbu sems rnam pa gnyis so// gnyis pa ni/ blo chen po bdun dang*/ mi ldan pa'i lam zhugs rnams ni theg pa chung ngu pa ste/ mtshan gzhi ni nyan rang rnams so// de dang ldan pa ni/ theg pa chen po pa ste/ mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen slob pa dang*/ mi slob pa rnams so// des na sde snod dang*/ grub mthas phye ba'i theg pa che chung gnyis re res kyang*/ rang gi sde snod dang*/ grub mtha' de'i nang du lam dang 'bras bus phye ba'i theg pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag byed cing*/ theg pa gsum gyi byang chub kyang*/ rang rang gi grub mtha' de kho na la gnas pas thob par 'dod pas nyan thos kyi sde snod 'dul ba lung lta bu nas kyang*/ theg pa gsum gyi gang zag dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi sems bskyed dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi bsngo ba dang smon lam/ theg pa gsum gyi lam dang 'bras bu rnams bshad

(27) cing*/ de nyid theg chen bkar ma 'dod pa'i nyan thos pa dag gis kyang khas len no// de'i dgongs pa mdo las kyang theg pa gsum gyi lam bsgrod tshul gsum dang*/ 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus gsum dang*/ khyad par du byang chub sems dpa' yis dang po sems bskyed pa'i tshul dang*/ grangs med gsum gnas skabs gang du rdzogs pa'i tshul dang*/ phar phyin drug gnas skabs gang du rdzogs pa'i tshul gsal bar gsung pas nyan thos kyi sde snod las/ nyan thos rang lugs kyi theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam sogs gsung par shes par bya'o// 'o na klu sgrub kyis de dag ma bshad par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ci snyam na/ gzhung 'di rin chen phreng bar theg chen bka' bsgrub kyi skabs su gsung pas/ nyan thos pa dag theg pa chen po bka' ma yin pas/ de la ma bslab kyang nyan thos kyi sde snod nyid la bslab pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par 'dod pa la de ni ma yin te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub nus kyi byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*/ sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa dang*/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ chos kyi bdag med rgyas pa sogs nyan thos kyi sde snod la ma bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don yin gyi grub mtha' khas len gyi nyan thos pa dag kho rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par 'dod kyang*/ dbu ma pas ni dbu ma'i gzhung las bshad pa'i lta spyod la ma brten par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub mi nus par bzhed pa'i gnad kyang 'di nyid yin no// gsum pa bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi ta'i bzhed pa'ang 'di nyid yin te/ so so thar pa'i mdo dang*/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las gsung pa'i bsngo ba de dag nyan thos pa rang la theg pa gsum yod pa'i theg chen gyi bsngo ba yin par 'dod kyang*/
